# Krishnendu Biswas

> Data and AI systems builder. MBA candidate at IIM Ranchi (2025 to 2027) with a Diploma in Programming from IIT Madras (2026). Published researcher with Springer (FICTA 2026).

## Overview
Krishnendu Biswas builds multi-agent operations platforms, complex data engineering pipelines, and fine-tuned AI models. Operating 12 domain profiles, 341 procedural skills, and 31 scheduled jobs on Hermes Agent with loopback model proxying and locked-down vault security.

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-Agent Operations Platforms (Hermes Agent, systemd, SQLite WAL)
- Model Routing and Tiered Compute (9Router loopback, provider fallback, script-first execution)
- Memory Systems and Telemetry (Vector memory, local embeddings, JSONL genesis ledger)
- Production Software (NestJS, React, Python, AWS EC2, PostgreSQL)
- Fine-Tuned NLP (PyTorch, HuggingFace, LoRA/PEFT, RoBERTa)

## Verified Case Studies
- [Multi-Agent Operations Platform](https://krishnendu.me/work/multi-agent-platform/): 12 domain profiles, 31 scheduled jobs, kanban orchestration.
- [Model Routing & Tiered Compute](https://krishnendu.me/work/model-routing-tiered-compute/): 3-tier complexity routing with deterministic script-first execution.
- [Memory Systems & Self-Documentation](https://krishnendu.me/work/memory-self-documentation/): Episodic vector memory, local embeddings, append-only ledger.
- [Reliability & Vault Security](https://krishnendu.me/work/reliability-security/): Filesystem-restricted vaults, encrypted GitHub backups, scripted DR restore.
- [Finance Ledger Agent](https://krishnendu.me/work/finance-ledger-agent/): Read-only Gmail receipt parser syncing to self-hosted Firefly III double-entry ledger.
- [Personal LinkedIn Studio](https://krishnendu.me/work/linkedin-studio/): Local drafting studio with anti-AI humanizer pass and human sign-off gate.
- [QualityKiosk Estimation Platform](https://krishnendu.me/work/qualitykiosk-estimation-platform/): RMS scoring across 349 banking processes in 11 domains.
- [Smart MCQ Solver](https://krishnendu.me/work/smart-mcq-solver-lora/): Fine-tuned Mistral-7B with LoRA, validated 0.74242 MAP@3 on Kaggle.
